outlooks.text_en: In the week of 19–25 October 2026 ATHENA followed 3654 events reported by at least two newsrooms (3113 new), covered in 113 countries. 82 reached high or critical risk (6/10 or more), against 32 the week before. Most events were in Geopolitics and Society & Law; the most widely covered region was Middle East & North Africa. The highest-risk event was “Israeli forces displace 2,000 Palestinians in Hebron after deadly attack on soldiers” (7.9/10). The period is still running; the figures change until it ends.
